title: When the Drop Turns
author: X. M. Amberdale
blurb: Lena Quintana, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
